data.name: Pair 'em Up

heroImage.alt: A number-matching puzzle with a grid of numbers and a highlighted cell, featuring tools to clear pairs that match or add up to 10

data.fullDescription: Pair 'em Up — a number-matching puzzle. Clear the grid by removing pairs of identical numbers or numbers that add up to 10, and reach 100 points before you run out of moves. Three modes: Classic, Random and Chaotic. Helpers like Hints, Revert, Add Numbers, Shuffle and Eraser are limited, so use them wisely.
